title: Card printing vendor review
lines: Let us review the card printing vendor. Their last batch was two weeks late.
They said the delay was a machine failure.
It is the second delay this year. I want a backup vendor.
Then we agree: we keep the current vendor until the contract ends in September, and we look for a backup.
Omar, please get two quotes from other vendors by the end of the month.
I will have two quotes by the end of the month.
I will write to the current vendor about the delays.
One more thing. We order fifty thousand cards for the next batch, not seventy thousand.
Do we know if the new chip supplier changes the price?
